info.title: Student Information Management API
info.description: Laboratory REST API. Login with JSON at /api/v1/auth/login, then paste access_token into Authorize. ADMIN and REGISTRAR manage academics; INSTRUCTOR reads assigned offerings and edits their grades; STUDENT reads only their own records. Grades use a 0–100 scale. All lists are paginated.

get.description: Paginate enrollments first, then group the page by academic term. A term may span pages; follow meta to retrieve the entire record. Instructors and administrators encode each subject grade; the response adds `gwa`, computed automatically from final grades weighted by units across the whole record (dropped and ungraded subjects are excluded). A GWA is never accepted as input. Registrars keep read-only access to this transcript.
Minimal instructor directory for administrators and registrars to assign course offerings. Does not expose account credentials or grant user-management access.
